Optional HX/HDPMI runtime files are not distributed with NitroQuake.

The original package identified for the optional benchmark path is:

  https://ibiblio.org/pub/micro/pc-stuff/freedos/files/util/system/hx-dos-extender/2.20/HXRT220.zip
  BIN/HDPMI32.EXE
  BIN/DPMI.EXE

The included HX documentation describes the runtime as freeware, but does not
provide sufficiently clear permission for this repository to redistribute the
executables or vendor documentation. Obtain the package independently, review
its terms, and pass its extracted directory with `-HdpmiRoot` when you choose
to run the optional HDPMI experiment.
